title: Dine & Donate at Bubba's 33 to Support Laredo Film Society on Tuesday
excerpt: Dine at Bubba's 33, 5706 San Bernardo Ave., all day Tuesday, Nov. 24, show the event graphic, and 10% of proceeds go to the Laredo Film Society to support border filmmakers and local moviegoers.
content:
A meal at Bubba's 33 on Tuesday can help put more local films on screen. The Laredo Film Society is holding a Dine & Donate fundraiser all day Tuesday, Nov. 24, at Bubba's 33, 5706 San Bernardo Ave.

Customers who dine in and show the event graphic when they pay will have 10% of their proceeds donated to the society, according to the Laredo Morning Times. There is no separate admission cost — the donation comes from the meal itself.

The money supports the society's work creating opportunities for filmmakers based along the border and for local movie lovers. Founded in 2018 by a group of friends and film enthusiasts, the society works to make moviegoing more accessible while supporting film and filmmaking in the community.
